recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create **Moonbite Yearning**, a portrait-first browser visual novel. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: start screen, tap/click typed dialogue, tap-to-finish-current-line, tap-to-advance, one two-option branch, route-specific continuation, ending overlay, and restart. Reinterpret the game as a satirical forbidden-romance fantasy set at rainy Ravenwood Academy. The player is a self-aware transfer student caught between Lucien, an immortal with excessive cheekbones, and Rowan, a wolf heir with pack drama. Use browser-native canvas/CSS for moonlit forest layers, rain, fireflies, bonfire glow, fang sigil, and readable gothic panels. Keep choices large and reachable on mobile portrait screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first visual novel / story choice game.
- objective: tap through typed dialogue, reach a branch, select one of two story routes, and view a route-complete ending.
- input model: click/tap on the dialogue panel to advance or reveal full text; click/tap on large choice and restart buttons.
- core loop: start screen -> animated scene -> typed dialogue -> player branch choice -> route dialogue -> ending overlay -> restart.
- fail/friction state: no combat failure; friction is choice commitment and route replay. End state pauses the animation loop and exposes restart.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve start button entry, typed text reveal, tap-to-skip typing, tap-to-advance, two-button branch, route-specific ending, and restart.
- Preserve canvas background loop and character visibility driven by scene state.
- Preserve mobile portrait readability, large CTAs, and native click/tap button behavior.

## Remix Trajectory
The beach arrival romance is rebuilt as **Moonbite Yearning**, a satirical forbidden-romance fantasy in a rainy immortal forest. Presentation, copy, HUD nouns, procedural scene art, audio mood, and focal character silhouettes change decisively while mechanics remain the same visual-novel route-selection loop.
